definitions: Relating to a world other than our own; supernatural or spiritual.
Having a quality that suggests a connection to a spiritual or imaginary realm; ethereal or unearthly.
Unconcerned with the practicalities of everyday life; dreamy or impractical.
examples: The artist's paintings had an other-worldly glow.
She had an other-worldly beauty that captivated everyone.
His other-worldly ideas were often difficult to implement.
